No lines need to be left out; everything is in the NEW MESSAGE body, with no attachments, quoted history, hidden or struck text. No quantities are vague, and all units are either stated or, for most, default to EA. One item ('12 rolls PTFE thread tape, white') clearly gives both quantity and non-standard UOM. No review is needed as the email is clear and complete.
